About this catalog

This catalog contains 43 Canadian and 41 US configurations from exact retailer or manufacturer listings. It is a configuration comparison, not an all-store price ranking. Current prices and stock must be confirmed at the retailer.

Unknown parts are shown on each detail page. No sale discount, FPS result or independent system test is inferred from a listing. Shipping, tax and return terms can change and depend on the seller. No paid placement is included in this cohort.
